title: Trump, Iran, and Brazil's Big Vote

slides.headline: Trump, Iran, and Brazil's Big Vote
slides.subtitle: Catch up on the world news that matters in just 60 seconds.

slides.headline: Trump proposes new Iran talks
slides.explanation: Donald Trump has suggested that new negotiations with Iran could start as early as Monday. It remains unclear if this will lead to a breakthrough as Tehran has not yet responded to the offer.

slides.headline: Massive wildfires hit Washington state
slides.explanation: Wildfires near Spokane have destroyed 600 structures and forced 60,000 people to evacuate their homes. Local and federal agencies are currently struggling to contain the spread of the flames.

slides.headline: Lula launches Brazil reelection campaign
slides.explanation: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has officially begun his bid for another term in office. His campaign launch comes amid growing concerns about potential foreign interference in the election.

slides.headline: Lula frames election as sovereignty fight
slides.explanation: Lula is positioning his reelection campaign as a defense against foreign interests. He is specifically highlighting the ties between the Bolsonaro family and Donald Trump to make his case.

slides.headline: Trump halts Iran strikes for a deal
slides.explanation: The US president says he cancelled planned military strikes against Iran to prioritize a potential nuclear deal. He claims this pause is also in response to requests from regional partners.

caption:
From shifting tensions in the Middle East to a major election campaign kicking off in Brazil, here is what you need to know today. title: Market Shifts and Fuel Theft

slides.headline: Market Shifts and Fuel Theft
slides.subtitle: Swipe to catch up on the five biggest finance stories of the day.

slides.headline: US and Japan intervene to save the yen
slides.explanation: The US and Japan are working together to stop the yen from falling further. They have promised to step in again if the currency needs more support.

slides.headline: Fuel theft is spiking across the UK
slides.explanation: Drivers are stealing nearly £200,000 worth of fuel from petrol stations every single day. This crime rate has jumped 20 percent since the conflict with Iran began.

slides.headline: Asian markets slide on tech selloff
slides.explanation: Stocks across Asia are falling as investors pull back from AI-related companies. Even with some optimism about global tensions, the tech dip is dragging the markets down.

slides.headline: South Korean chip stocks take a hit
slides.explanation: The KOSPI index in South Korea dropped 4 percent following a rough month for the country's major chip makers. This marks the worst monthly performance for the index since 2008.

slides.headline: Bank stocks are on a winning streak
slides.explanation: Financial stocks are hitting record highs thanks to strong earnings and solid valuations. Experts think this rally for the banking sector might just be getting started.
